channel.title: Potomac Local News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Potomac Local News (potomaclocal.com)

item.title: Power Issues Disrupt Stafford County Schools
item.description: Power and internet issues disrupted operations at several Stafford County Public Schools today, affecting phones and connectivity as students returned to class on a regular schedule following last week’s snowstorm.

item.title: Police Department Welcomes New Officer
item.description: “Prince William County Police Department welcomes Officer Stephen Lawson who joins us through the Virginia Certified Lateral program,” Prince William County Police Department announced.

item.title: Jury Convicts Man In 2023 I-95 Killing
item.description: The Prince William County Commonwealth’s Attorney’s Office issued statements this week on two separate criminal cases, announcing a jury verdict in a deadly 2023 abduction and homicide and sentencing in a decades-old cold case involving abduction and rape.

item.title: Obituary: Kathleen “Kathie” Eckert (1943-2026)
item.description: In loving memory of Kathleen "Kathie" Eckert, who passed away in 2026 at the age of 82.

item.title: County Votes To Raise Police Pay
item.description: The Prince William Board of County Supervisors approved a new police pay agreement Tuesday night, raising starting salaries and adjusting future pay scales as the county seeks to improve recruitment and retention.

item.title: Spanberger Issues New Policing Order
item.description: Gov. Abigail Spanberger, Democrat, issued a new executive order establishing statewide principles for law enforcement and directed Virginia agencies to end participation in federal civil immigration enforcement agreements.

item.title: ICE Rumors Roil Stafford Supervisors Meeting
item.description: Stafford County leaders faced heightened public concern Feb. 3, 2026 as residents pressed the Board of Supervisors about rumors that an ICE detention or processing facility could be located in the county, a debate unfolding the same week Virginia’s governor issued a sweeping new policing order tied to immigration enforcement.

item.title: Peace Monks Draw Crowd Downtown
item.description: A group of Buddhist monks walking from Texas to Washington, D.C., passed through Fredericksburg as residents gathered along Sophia Street to watch their journey for peace and compassion.

item.title: Vega Casts Lone Vote Against Police Pay Deal
item.description: Prince William County Supervisor Yesli Vega cast the lone vote against a newly approved police pay agreement, raising concerns about data, fiscal risk, and the county’s use of collective bargaining.

item.title: Townhouse Fire Displaces 5 near Manassas
item.description: Fire crews responded late Friday morning to reports of a townhouse on fire in the 10900 block of Hiram Court in Manassas, according to a fire department release.
